resources.string: You can do today\'s crew run
With %1$d runners · used %2$s of %3$s crew stamina
%1$d members did a crew run here today
Crew stamina is the max durability of every shoe picked before the start, added up and multiplied by the crew level bonus. Each runner uses %1$s per minute, and everyone gets the same share.
When the crew stamina runs out, you stop earning. Your run keeps recording.
Crew runs do not use your energy or your shoe durability. You can still do a free run the same day.
Rewards use the efficiency of the shoe you picked, plus the headcount bonus and the crew level bonus.
It is a crew run when 2 or more crew members start together in the crew room and are still within %2$dm of each other %1$d minutes after the start.
One crew run a day. Pausing is fine, but once you finish, that day\'s crew run is over. It opens again at 00:00 (Korea time).
If you lose your group and run alone, the crew run ends after 1 minute.
A crew room holds up to %1$d runners.
The level rises with the distance each runner covers in crew runs. The top level is 20.
Your crew has run %1$skm together in crew runs.
Level bonus now — crew stamina +%1$s%% · rewards +%2$s%%
Each level adds crew stamina +%1$s%% and rewards +%2$s%%.
Finish your first crew run to reach Lv.1.
The max durability of the shoe you pick is added to crew stamina, and rewards use its efficiency. Shoes do not wear down in crew runs.
Could not change the shoe. Please try again.
This is a preview. The server counts the crew members within %2$dm of you %1$d minutes after the start.
You already did today\'s crew run. It opens again at 00:00 tomorrow (Korea time).
There is no crew stamina, so this crew run will not earn.
Starting begins today\'s crew run. Once you finish, the next one is tomorrow.
Crew stamina is used up · from now on the run records but does not earn
Crew members running together are counted %1$d minutes after the start
No crew member nearby · come back within %1$dm in 1 minute to keep the crew run going
Finishing ends today\'s crew run. You can do it again tomorrow.
Crew runs earn with crew stamina. Your energy and shoe durability stay the same.
Crew stamina is used up, so you do not earn from now on.
Crew stamina used up · still recording
You stopped earning after the crew stamina ran out.
You stopped earning after you were left alone.
This run did not count as a crew run. No crew member was with you 2 minutes after the start, or you already did today\'s crew run.
Today\'s crew run is done · available again at 00:00 tomorrow (Korea time)
